item.title: Philadelphia Museum of Art Says Goodbye to “PhAM”
item.description: “There was no good reason to rename it,” Director Daniel Weiss told Hyperallergic about the museum’s decision to backpedal on a controversial new name.

item.title: When Will MoMA Dump Leon Black?

item.title: Frankenthaler Climate Initiative Opens Applications for Sixth Grant Cycle
item.description: The program has awarded more than $17.5 million to US visual arts organizations pursuing energy efficiency assessments and projects.

item.title: 8 Art Books to Read This February
item.description: The trailblazing sculptural practice of Edmonia Lewis, the birth of modernism in Montmartre, the luminous paintings of Kaylene Whiskey, and Gainsborough’s alluring fashion portraits are among our favorite reads this month.

item.description: The entire team of in-house photojournalists was also cut, as were multiple critics and editors across the Bezos-owned paper’s culture section.

item.description: “We love that we’re able to make art as queer artists inside a church.”

item.title: National Gallery of Art Acquires Stirring Artemisia Masterpiece
item.description: “Mary Magdalene in Ecstasy” (c. 1625) is the first work by the Italian Baroque artist to enter the institution’s collection.

item.description: The London curator is tapped to curate the SITE biennial, Mnuchin Gallery closes, a buyer spends big money on a tiny Michelangelo foot drawing, and other industry news.
